gen-comfortaa-gf-elms-sans: Comfortaa draws every stroke like glowing neon tubing, with a ring-shaped c and letters spread out like a loosened spring. Elms Sans follows in a plain sans line, pressure-free as a ballpoint, with gaps you can see through in each s.
gen-comfortaa-gf-hubot-sans: Comfortaa looks like wire bent into friendly geometric shapes, its c a wide ring and its letters stretched apart. And Hubot Sans, a modern sans-serif with a generously opened e, gives that wiry display line a sturdier partner below.
gen-comfortaa-gf-imprima: That ring-shaped c gives Comfortaa away: neon-tube strokes, loosely spaced letters, a friendly geometric manner. Imprima then follows with smooth tube-like lines and terminals that flare outward, so the plain sans below feels like a softer cousin.
gen-comfortaa-gf-jost: Round, glowing, and a bit playful. Comfortaa spaces its neon-tube letters wide apart, and Jost then carries the text with broad terminal gaps and a unit-width stroke, a sans-serif that keeps going without fuss.
gen-comfortaa-gf-kanchenjunga: Comfortaa leads with wide-open ring shapes and neon-tube strokes, friendly and loose in its spacing. But Kanchenjunga, a sans-serif drawn like a technical pen, holds up at low resolution, though a very small Comfortaa heading would lose its glow.
gen-comfortaa-gf-koho: Comfortaa draws curves and straights with the same line width, its c a wide ring and its spacing stretched like a spring. KoHo takes over as a sans with wide c apertures, and the heading does its best work when it is large and short.
gen-comfortaa-gf-kosugi: Friendly is the first word for Comfortaa, with its neon-tube strokes and wide ring of a c. But Kosugi sits beside it like bent wire, an open-jawed c and a plain sans look that make the two feel like close relatives.
gen-comfortaa-gf-kulim-park: A c shaped like a wide-open ring is the giveaway in Comfortaa, along with its neon-tube strokes and stretched spacing. And Kulim Park, a sans with wide gaps in the e, lets that heading shine when it is large and brief.
gen-comfortaa-gf-lato: Comfortaa draws horizontals as heavy as verticals, like neon tubing bent into friendly geometry. Lato, a sans-serif with wide s curves barely curled in, steps in below, and the heading does its finest work when it is big and brief.
gen-comfortaa-gf-m-plus-1p: M PLUS 1p reads clean and open, with every curve end left wide, like a sans-serif that never crowds a line. Comfortaa above it, drawn with a fixed-width nib, makes that openness the thing the pair does best.
